blocks.text: Memo: overtime is not a skip-scan license

This is the working cut for PCF-MEM-2024-033 on April 4, 2024. Tasha Quinn asked for a written bound after the current path (OT 1.5x Friday, skip-scan tribal) stopped being honest. I am Jeilen Jones, Order Picker, writing for Marcus Hale, Tasha Quinn, and Ben Crowe. Primary host huddle.pinecrest.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on buy Friday rate with skip-scan, then open questions. If you are on the floor next shift, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the steps.

Friday OT stays. Skip-scan stays a write-up. Add one packer before raising pick OT. I am not restating a hallway yes. buy Friday rate with skip-scan is out because That is how January 12 shipped 14 wrong totes. Cash saved on labor is spent on reships. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: ot=1.5, mispicks=14, packer=1, reship=2.7, weeks=1, friday=1, uph=310, hole=1. Sibling tickets PCF-1612 and PCF-INC-2024-008. I will not reopen buy Friday rate with skip-scan in a side thread because someone asked for a rate waiver. Tasha Quinn is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.

blocks.text: Friday OT stays. Skip-scan stays a write-up. Add one packer before raising pick OT.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Ben Crowe owns a leftover that is easy to skip: pack.pinecrest.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (09): refuse on buy Friday rate with skip-scan, lock is OT yes, skip-scan no, extra packer first. I will not hide a process change inside a 'quick align' on PCF-1612.
If OT only works when we skip scans, we do not have a labor plan. We have a quality hole.

What a skeptical lead would try first on huddle.pinecrest.internal: the path Tasha Quinn actually has, not an empty-tote photo. Metric I will argue is a clean confirm, not a vanity units-per-hour. If we cannot show that path on wms.pinecrest.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Jeilen Jones will not accept a hallway yes as that proof.
Constraints and the lock
